Bug Title: Login fails with 500 on invalid OTP
Preconditions: User account exists, valid email, OTP flow enabled
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Request password reset. 2. Enter email and submit. 3. Enter expired/invalid OTP. 4. Submit OTP.
Expected Result: System displays validation error ("Invalid or expired OTP") and allows retry.
Actual Result: Server returns HTTP 500 and generic error page; user can't retry.
Notes: Assume OTP expiry handling bug in Otp model or authController when verifying invalid tokens.

Bug Title: Save Job action duplicates entry in Saved list
Preconditions: User logged in; job not yet saved
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open a job details page. 2. Click Save Job twice quickly. 3. Go to Saved Jobs page.
Expected Result: Job appears once in Saved list; second click is disabled while request pending.
Actual Result: Job appears twice in Saved list (duplicate entries).
Notes: Likely missing client-side debounce or server-side idempotency check on SavedJob creation.

Bug Title: Search filters reset after pagination
Preconditions: Multiple filters applied (location, salary); results >1 page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Apply filters. 2. Click to go to page 2 of results.
Expected Result: Filters remain applied while paginating and results reflect same filters.
Actual Result: Filters reset to defaults and user sees unfiltered results.
Notes: Assume front-end routing loses query params when changing pages.

Bug Title: Applying to job shows Application submitted but status not updated

Expected Result: Application status shows Applied and application appears in dashboard.
Actual Result: UI shows success toast but dashboard still shows no application.
Notes: Possible backend transaction not persisting Application record or frontend caching issue.

Bug Title: Employer cannot access applicant details (403) despite being owner
